data.title: 波岛出海 · 初中校门石阶的欢快飞跃
data.description: 阳光明丽的初中正门石阶上，出海双手抱着装满原稿的书包轻盈跳下两级台阶，双马尾在半空中飞扬，回眸仰头满脸期待地等待前辈的摸头奖励。
data.location: sunlit brick stairs outside school main gate framed by green hedges and blooming flowers
data.action: hopping down stone stairs clutching schoolbag, turning back with expectant puppy-like sparkle in amber eyes, seeking praise
data.lighting: 校门正上方倾泻而下的清澈午后阳光
data.promptProse: Izumi hops down the school gate steps with her bag clutched tight, turning with an eager, sparkling smile waiting for headpats.
data.animaCaption: Bright afternoon sunlight catches her floating twintails as she lands lightly on the stairs.
